data.one_liner: Render LaTeX equations with text support using flutter_math_fork
data.what_it_does: latext provides a widget that parses a string containing LaTeX delimiters and renders the math parts with flutter_math_fork while the surrounding text is rendered as normal RichText. It works on Android, iOS, Web and Desktop without using WebView.
use_when: Need to display inline or block LaTeX equations inside normal text
Want cross‑platform support without JavaScript or WebView
Require the ability to mix plain text and math in a single widget
avoid_when: Performance critical rendering of very large or complex equations
Projects that already use a full KaTeX or MathJax integration
strengths: Inherits text style from parent widgets
Supports inline and block math with delimiters
weaknesses: Relies on flutter_math_fork, so limited to its feature set
No support for advanced KaTeX features like custom macros
Potentially slower for very large equations
